RID2Caltopo modification and relinking permissions

RID2Caltopo's original application code and supplied application object code
are licensed under Apache License 2.0. To the extent the application authors
control the relevant rights, recipients may modify the work for their own use,
replace FFmpeg with a modified compatible version, relink the application using
the supplied objects and link inputs, and reverse engineer the work for debugging
those modifications. These permissions are intended to preserve the rights
required by LGPL 2.1 section 6 and impose no additional restriction on them.

Third-party source, objects and libraries retain their respective licenses.
The accompanying full notices identify those terms. Inclusion of optional Eigen
or FFmpeg source and COPYING files does not assert that optional components are
linked into the application. Eigen source and any locally supplied build
configuration are provided with the corresponding materials in the relink ZIP.

Apple SDKs, operating-system frameworks and signing credentials are not included.
Recipients obtain their own development tools and use their own signing identity
and provisioning arrangements when installing a modified build. No original
developer signing key, device data, or service access credential is required to
produce the unsigned executable. Third-party service access remains subject to
the relevant operator's account and permissions.
